reviews.title: Overall Great app, try it
reviews.text: I’ve been using Cal plus for a while now and i love how it’s really an all in one app. The milestone feature is fun to keep track of your streaks and i love that you can track all your progress from weight, to calories, to workouts, habits, this app is my favorite calorie tracking app. When it comes to ai scanning, it works well for estimates although It is always better to just weigh your food and put it into the app. I use the ai scanner for when i go out to eat and cannot weigh my food and it helps me stay in track with my calories.

reviews.title: Visually Nice but Functionally Lacking
reviews.text:
The UI is very nice and appealing but the functionality of tracking macros are not there, sometimes off by hundreds of grams. 

If you are serious about your tracking this app is not there yet at the time of this post.
 
I really like the idea behind the app, free and with ads for every meal entry. But its main functionality being a HUGE weak point is the breaking point. 

This is a relatively easy fix, which will for sure take the app to the next level.
